description: Different model profiles should preserve Vapor MongoDB planning decisions, including aggregation, dynamic filter, pagination, and write/update boundary coverage.

lockedFields.reason: The checked-in Vapor MongoDB fixture has Swift Testing, XCTVapor, and a runnable swift test command.
SwiftPM Vapor fixtures should keep using swift test as the verification command.
The aggregation route, search route, and write/update job should all remain add-test candidates.
The aggregation route should remain the first high-priority integration candidate.
MongoDB-backed Vapor routes should be planned as integration coverage.
Aggregation pipeline semantics must stay visible to downstream model prompts.
The dynamic search route should remain a first-class integration candidate.
Dynamic BSON filter construction must stay visible to downstream model prompts.
Pagination and sort behavior should stay pinned as a separate risk signal.
The write/update job should remain an integration candidate instead of being treated as generic worker orchestration.
MongoDB create/update behavior must stay visible to downstream model prompts.
